Tô, corn paste, is the staple food of the cuisine

bi.name: Burundi
descriptions: Small mountainous country in East Africa
Bordered by Lake Tanganyika, second deepest in the world
The ritual drums of Burundi are inscribed on the UNESCO list
One of the sources of the Nile takes root on its territory
Producer of very high quality arabica coffee

cv.name: Cape Verde
descriptions: Volcanic archipelago of 10 islands in the Atlantic Ocean
Home of singer Cesária Évora, voice of morna
Pico do Fogo is an active volcano peaking at 2,829 meters
Population descended from Portuguese sailors and African slaves
Sea turtles come to lay eggs on its pristine beaches

cm.name: Cameroon
descriptions: Nicknamed Africa in miniature for its landscape diversity
Has over 250 different languages spoken in the country
Mount Cameroon peaks at 4,040 meters, highest summit in West Africa
The Indomitable Lions are a legendary football team
Important producer of cocoa for the global chocolate industry

cf.name: Central African Republic
descriptions: Landlocked country in the heart of the African continent
Dzanga-Sangha Park shelters rainforest wildlife
Shelters lowland gorillas and forest elephants
The Oubangui forms a natural border to the south
Cassava and river fish are the basis of the cuisine

td.name: Chad
descriptions: Lake Chad provides water to millions of inhabitants
The Tibesti massif is made of volcanic peaks
Houses one of the last elephant herds of the Sahel
The Ennedi rock paintings date back 7,000 years
Over 200 ethnic groups coexist in this vast country

km.name: Comoros
descriptions: Volcanic archipelago of 4 islands in the Indian Ocean
Producer of ylang-ylang, a precious flower for perfume
Karthala is an active volcano on the island of Grande Comore
Also called the Islands of the Moon in Arabic
Home of paradise beaches lined with coconut trees

cg.name: Republic of the Congo
descriptions: Brazzaville and Kinshasa are the closest capitals in the world
The Congo River is the 2nd most powerful in the world
Covered 65% by equatorial tropical forest
Shelters western lowland gorillas
Brazzaville is a cradle of Congolese rumba, listed by UNESCO

cd.name: DR Congo
descriptions: Fourth most populous country in Africa with 95 million inhabitants
The Congo River crosses the country over 4,700 km
Has 5 natural UNESCO sites including the Salonga forest
Shelters the bonobo, primate unique in the world
Ndombolo, rumba dance, is famous throughout Africa

ci.name: Ivory Coast
descriptions: World's leading cocoa producer with 40% of production
Yamoussoukro houses the largest basilica in the world after St. Peter's
Abidjan is the economic capital nicknamed Little Paris
Home of famous footballer Didier Drogba
Baoulé and Senufo masks animate traditional ceremonies

dj.name: Djibouti
descriptions: Country located in the Horn of Africa near the strategic strait
Lake Assal is the lowest point in Africa at -155 meters
One of the saltiest lakes in the world after the Dead Sea
Shelters whale sharks in the Gulf of Tadjoura
Crossroads between Africa, Middle East and Asia since Antiquity

eg.name: Egypt
descriptions: Cradle of one of the oldest civilizations in the world
The Pyramids of Giza are 4,500 years old and unique in the world
The Nile is the longest river in the world at 6,650 km
Cairo is the largest city in Africa
Inventor of hieroglyphic writing 5,000 years old

gq.name: Equatorial Guinea
descriptions: Only African country with Spanish as official language
Composed of a continental part and several islands
Malabo is located on Bioko Island and not on the mainland
Rich in oil and equatorial tropical forests
Shelters lowland gorillas in its dense forests

er.name: Eritrea
descriptions: Asmara is nicknamed Little Rome for its Art Deco buildings
Bordered by the Red Sea over 1,000 km of coastline
African country that became independent in 1993
Has over 350 islands in the Dahlak archipelago
Ge'ez is the script used by the Orthodox Church

sz.name: Eswatini
descriptions: Small southern African kingdom landlocked between South Africa and Mozambique
Former name Swaziland before being renamed in 2018
Still has an active absolute monarchy
The Reed Festival is a traditional national ceremony
Elephants and rhinos live in its nature reserves

et.name: Ethiopia
descriptions: Never lastingly colonised, it repelled Italy at Adwa in 1896
Cradle of humanity with the Lucy skeleton 3.2 million years old
Has its own 13-month calendar and a unique time zone
Cradle of coffee said to have been discovered in Kaffa
The rock-hewn churches of Lalibela are carved into the rock

ga.name: Gabon
descriptions: Covered 85% by dense equatorial tropical forest
Has 13 national parks protecting gorillas and elephants
The country is crossed by the geographic equator
Cradle of Punu culture and its white masks
Production of manganese, an essential material for industry

gm.name: Gambia
descriptions: Smallest continental country in Africa by area
Entirely enclosed in Senegal except at the river mouth
The Gambia River crosses it from end to end
Shelters over 540 migratory bird species
The colorful fishing pirogues animate its beaches

gh.name: Ghana
descriptions: First sub-Saharan African country to gain independence in 1957
Second world producer of cocoa after Ivory Coast
Kente fabric with colorful patterns is handmade
Lake Volta is the largest artificial lake in the world by surface
Home of famous footballer Asamoah Gyan

gn.name: Guinea
descriptions: Nicknamed the water tower of West Africa
The sources of the Niger and Senegal rise in its mountains
World's leading producer of bauxite, ore for aluminum
Mount Nimba is UNESCO-listed for its biodiversity
Home of singer Mory Kanté and his famous Yéké Yéké

gw.name: Guinea-Bissau
descriptions: Small coastal West African country with a thousand islands
The Bijagós archipelago is inscribed on the UNESCO list
Shelters marine hippos, rare in the world
Important producer of cashews exported worldwide
Portuguese official language since colonization

ke.name: Kenya
descriptions: The Masai Mara hosts the great wildebeest migration every year
Mount Kenya peaks at 5,199 meters, second summit in Africa
Home of the fastest long-distance runners in the world
Cradle of humanity with many fossils discovered
Nairobi is the only capital in the world with a national park within it

ls.name: Lesotho
descriptions: Mountainous kingdom entirely enclosed within South Africa
Nicknamed the kingdom in the sky for its high average altitude
The entire country is above 1,000 meters altitude
Basotho shepherds wear a traditional colorful blanket
Producer of diamonds extracted in the mountains

lr.name: Liberia
descriptions: Country founded by former freed American slaves in 1822
Monrovia bears the name of American President James Monroe
English is the official language since its founding
Has the world's largest merchant fleet by tonnage
Its forests shelter rare pygmy hippos

ly.name: Libya
descriptions: 90% of the territory is desert, dominated by the Sahara
Has 5 UNESCO sites including the Roman ruins of Leptis Magna
Bordered to the north by the long Mediterranean coast
The white and black desert offers lunar landscapes
Historic home of the Berbers, indigenous people of North Africa

mg.name: Madagascar
descriptions: Fourth largest island in the world in the Indian Ocean
Shelters unique species like lemurs and baobabs
90% of the fauna is endemic and found nowhere else
Has the Avenue of the Baobabs, iconic landscape of Morondava
World's leading producer of fragrant vanilla

mw.name: Malawi
descriptions: Lake Malawi occupies one fifth of the country's surface area
Shelters over 1,000 species of colorful cichlid fish
Nicknamed the warm heart of Africa for its hospitality
Mount Mulanje peaks at 3,002 meters and rises from the plains
Nsima, corn paste, is the daily staple food

ml.name: Mali
descriptions: Timbuktu was a great intellectual center in the Middle Ages
Has the largest mud mosque in the world at Djenné
Home of the famous Festival in the Desert at Essakane
The Niger River crosses the country over 1,700 km
The country's Dogon masks are among the most beautiful in Africa

mr.name: Mauritania
descriptions: Covered 90% by the Sahara Desert with immense dunes
The longest train in the world carries iron ore over 700 km
Has four historic caravan cities UNESCO-listed
The Banc d'Arguin is a paradise for millions of migratory birds
Women paint their hands with henna for festivals

mu.name: Mauritius
descriptions: Tropical Indian Ocean island with turquoise waters
Home of the dodo, iconic bird that disappeared in the 17th century
Chamarel waterfall flows between lands of 7 colors
One of the oldest sugar plantations in the Indian Ocean
Creole is spoken by everyone, French and English at school

ma.name: Morocco
descriptions: Country with 4 mountain ranges: Rif, Middle, High and Anti-Atlas
The medina of Fez is the largest pedestrian zone in the world
Producer of argan oil, precious cosmetic oil
Couscous is inscribed on the UNESCO heritage list
Essaouira goats climb argan trees

mz.name: Mozambique
descriptions: Has over 2,500 km of coastline on the Indian Ocean
The Bazaruto archipelago shelters dugongs and multicolored corals
Portuguese is the official language inherited from colonization
Piri-piri, small hot pepper, is used everywhere in the cuisine
Mozambique Island was the first Portuguese overseas capital

na.name: Namibia
descriptions: The Namib Desert is said to be the oldest desert in the world
Has the highest dunes in the world at Sossusvlei
First country in the world to write environmental protection into its constitution
Shelters the famous desert elephants adapted to aridity
The Skeleton Coast is strewn with shipwrecks

ne.name: Niger
descriptions: Landlocked Sahel country crossed by the Niger River
The Ténéré desert offers lunar landscapes
The Tree of Ténéré was the most isolated tree in the world
Saharan dinosaur fossils are numerous here
The Cure Salée festival brings together nomads every year

ng.name: Nigeria
descriptions: Most populous country in Africa with 220 million inhabitants
Has over 500 different languages spoken in the country
Nollywood is the most prolific film industry in Africa
Leading oil producer in Africa
The country is known for the bronze masks of Benin

rw.name: Rwanda
descriptions: Nicknamed the land of a thousand hills for its green relief
Shelters the last mountain gorillas in Volcanoes Park
Banned plastic bags back in 2008, among the first countries to do so
One of the cleanest and safest capitals in Africa
Ubudehe is a tradition of mutual aid between neighbors

st.name: Sao Tome and Principe
descriptions: Small volcanic archipelago in the Gulf of Guinea
Pico Cão Grande is a unique rocky peak of 663 meters
Producer of very high quality cocoa since colonial times
Portuguese is the official language of this small country
Shelters still-preserved black volcanic sand beaches

sn.name: Senegal
descriptions: Has the westernmost point of the African continent
Gorée Island is a major memorial site of slavery
Lake Retba owes its color to a microscopic bacterium
Home of teranga, hospitality celebrated worldwide
Mbalax is the national musical rhythm popularized by Youssou N'Dour

sc.name: Seychelles
descriptions: Archipelago of 115 paradise islands in the Indian Ocean
Victoria is one of the smallest capitals in the world
The coco de mer produces the largest seed of the plant kingdom
White sand beaches lined with unique granite rocks
Shelters the Aldabra giant tortoise, one of the largest in the world

sl.name: Sierra Leone
descriptions: Freetown was founded by former freed slaves
West African country bordered by the Atlantic Ocean
The centuries-old cotton tree of Freetown is a national symbol
Beaches line the Freetown Peninsula
World's leading producer of rutile, titanium ore

so.name: Somalia
descriptions: Has the longest coastline in Africa at 3,300 km
Country in the Horn of Africa at the eastern tip
Cradle of the culture of camel nomads
Frankincense stone has been harvested since Antiquity
The Laas Geel rock paintings are over 5,000 years old

za.name: South Africa
descriptions: Only country in the world with three capitals: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein
Has 11 official languages and great cultural diversity
Kruger National Park shelters the Big Five animals of Africa
Home of Nelson Mandela, Nobel Peace Prize laureate
Producer of gold and diamonds since the 19th century

ss.name: South Sudan
descriptions: Youngest country in the world, independent since July 9, 2011
The White Nile crosses the country over hundreds of kilometers
The Sudd is one of the largest wetlands in the world
Shelters the second largest mammal migration in the world
Over 60 different ethnic groups live in its territory

sd.name: Sudan
descriptions: The White Nile and Blue Nile meet at Khartoum
Has more pyramids than Egypt with those of Meroë
The Nubian Desert covers a large part of its north
The kingdoms of Kush ruled here 3,000 years ago
Ful medames, cooked fava beans, is the traditional breakfast

tz.name: Tanzania
descriptions: Kilimanjaro peaks at 5,895 meters, highest summit in Africa
The Serengeti hosts the largest animal migration in the world
The Zanzibar archipelago is a paradise of fragrant spices
The Ngorongoro crater is a unique caldera with its wildlife
Swahili is spoken everywhere in the country

tg.name: Togo
descriptions: Small coastal West African country, long and narrow
Lomé is the only African capital bordered by the sea
The tata mud villages are UNESCO-listed
The fetish market in Lomé is the largest in West Africa
Producer of phosphate, one of its main resources

tn.name: Tunisia
descriptions: North African country bordered by the Mediterranean Sea
The ruins of Carthage tell a thousand-year-old story
The Tozeur oasis has over 400,000 date palms
Several Star Wars scenes were filmed in the desert
Tunisian couscous is served with a spicy harissa sauce

ug.name: Uganda
descriptions: Nicknamed the pearl of Africa by Winston Churchill
Lake Victoria, second largest freshwater lake in the world, borders it
Shelters half of the remaining mountain gorillas on Earth
The country has over 1,000 different bird species
At Murchison Falls the Nile squeezes through a 7-metre gap

zm.name: Zambia
descriptions: Shares with Zimbabwe the Victoria Falls on the Zambezi River
Victoria Falls is one of the seven natural wonders
Has over 70 different ethnic groups living in harmony
Africa's second-largest copper exporter behind DR Congo
Nshima, a maize porridge, comes with nearly every meal

zw.name: Zimbabwe
descriptions: Shares the Victoria Falls with Zambia on the Zambezi
Great Zimbabwe is a stone city 800 years old
Its currency experienced the most extreme inflation in history
Home of the Zimbabwe Bird, national sculpture in soapstone
Has 16 official languages including English and Shona

ag.name: Antigua and Barbuda
descriptions: Small Caribbean country composed of two main islands
Has 365 beaches, one for each day of the year
Calypso and soca rhythm local festivals
Independent from the United Kingdom since 1981
Nelson's Dockyard is UNESCO-listed

ar.name: Argentina
descriptions: Home of tango, passionate dance born in Buenos Aires
The Iguazú Falls count 275 cascades on the Brazilian border
Mount Aconcagua peaks at 6,961 meters, highest summit in the Americas
The Argentine pampa is an immense plain where gauchos live
World's leading consumer of beef per capita

bs.name: Bahamas
descriptions: An archipelago of 700 islands and islets in the Atlantic Ocean
Christopher Columbus landed on these islands in 1492
Turquoise waters shelter the famous swimming pigs of Exuma
Home of Junkanoo, colorful New Year festival
Dean's Blue Hole is one of the deepest in the world

bb.name: Barbados
descriptions: Small coral island in the eastern Caribbean
Home of singer Rihanna born in Bridgetown
Cradle of rum whose production dates back to the 17th century
Cricket is the national sport since colonial times
Independent from the United Kingdom since 1966

bz.name: Belize
descriptions: Has the second largest barrier reef in the world
The Great Blue Hole is a well-known diving site
Home of ancient Mayan cities hidden in the jungle
Only country in Central America with English as official language
Has over 500 bird species in its forests

bo.name: Bolivia
descriptions: The Salar de Uyuni is the largest salt desert in the world
La Paz is the highest administrative capital in the world at 3,600 m
Has 37 official languages including Aymara and Quechua
Lake Titicaca is the highest navigable lake in the world
World's leading producer of quinoa, ancestral super-food

br.name: Brazil
descriptions: Fifth largest country in the world by area
The Amazon covers 60% of the country and shelters unique biodiversity
Home of the famous Rio carnival and world champion football
Christ the Redeemer in Rio is one of the 7 new wonders
World's leading coffee producer for 150 years

ca.name: Canada
descriptions: Second largest country in the world by area
Has the longest coastline in the world at 202,000 km
Home of maple syrup produced in abundance in Quebec
Niagara Falls form a grandiose natural spectacle
Officially bilingual with French and English

cl.name: Chile
descriptions: Longest country in the world at 4,300 km from north to south
The Atacama Desert is the driest place in the world
Has Easter Island and its mysterious moai
Patagonia has many glaciers
World's leading copper producer for a long time

co.name: Colombia
descriptions: Second most biodiverse country in the world after Brazil
Home of the famous Juan Valdez coffee
Birthplace of writer Gabriel García Márquez, Nobel laureate
The salsa of Cali makes the whole country dance
The Colombian emerald is the most precious in the world

cr.name: Costa Rica
descriptions: Country without an army since 1948, pioneer of peace
Shelters 6% of world biodiversity on 0.03% of land
First country in the world to reach 99% renewable energy
Pura vida is the national philosophy of simple happiness
Sloths and toucans live in its tropical forests

cu.name: Cuba
descriptions: Largest island in the Caribbean bathed by the Atlantic
Home of salsa and the famous Cuban cigar
1950s American vintage cars still cruise the streets
Havana is UNESCO-listed for its historic center
Baseball is the most popular national sport

dm.name: Dominica
descriptions: Small Caribbean island nicknamed the nature island
The Boiling Lake is one of the largest in the world
Covered 60% by primary tropical forest
Home of the last Carib Indians of the Antilles
Home to the sisserou parrot, the national bird in purple and green

do.name: Dominican Republic
descriptions: Santo Domingo is the oldest colonial city in the Americas
Shares the island of Hispaniola with Haiti
World's leading producer of quality cigars
Pico Duarte is the highest peak in the Caribbean at 3,098 m
Home of merengue and bachata, lively dances

ec.name: Ecuador
descriptions: Crossed by the equator, the imaginary line that gives it its name
Quito is the world's second-highest capital at 2,850 m
Has the Galápagos Islands, paradise for Charles Darwin
The Cotopaxi volcano is one of the highest active volcanoes in the world
Home of fine flavor cocoa, among the best in the world

sv.name: El Salvador
descriptions: Smallest continental country in Central America
Nicknamed the land of volcanoes with over 20 active cones
Bordered by the Pacific Ocean with famous surfing waves
Pupusa, stuffed corn pancake, is the national dish
First country in the world to adopt Bitcoin as legal currency

gd.name: Grenada
descriptions: Nicknamed the Spice Isle for its Caribbean fragrances
Second world producer of nutmeg after Indonesia
The national flag contains a stylized nutmeg
Has an underwater sculpture park
Small island country in the eastern Caribbean

gt.name: Guatemala
descriptions: Cradle of Mayan civilization with the ruins of Tikal
Has 37 volcanoes, 4 of them active today
Lake Atitlán is nicknamed the most beautiful lake in the world
Producer of very high quality arabica coffee
Home of Nobel Peace Prize laureate Rigoberta Menchú

gy.name: Guyana
descriptions: Only English-speaking country in South America
Kaieteur Falls are 5 times higher than Niagara
Covered 80% by primary tropical forest
Mount Roraima inspired Pixar's film Up
The Essequibo delta shelters varied wildlife

ht.name: Haiti
descriptions: First Black republic in history, independent in 1804
Shares the island of Hispaniola with the Dominican Republic
Haitian Creole is spoken by the entire population
Has Citadelle Laferrière, largest fortress in the Americas
Cradle of compas and kompa, lively music

hn.name: Honduras
descriptions: Bordered by the Caribbean to the north and the Pacific to the south
The Bay Islands shelter the second largest coral barrier reef
Copán is a Mayan site famous for its carved stelae
Leading coffee producer in Central America
The Mosquitia is a little-known and preserved tropical forest

jm.name: Jamaica
descriptions: Cradle of reggae, popularized by Bob Marley
Has over 120 rivers and 50 waterfalls
Runner Usain Bolt is the fastest man in history
Producer of the famous Blue Mountain high altitude coffee
Rastafari is a religious and cultural movement born here

mx.name: Mexico
descriptions: Home of Mayan and Aztec cities and the Day of the Dead
Mexico City is the highest capital in North America at 2,240 m
Has over 34 sites listed by UNESCO
Chocolate was invented by the Mayans 3,000 years ago
World's leading producer of avocados with the orchards of Michoacán

ni.name: Nicaragua
descriptions: Largest country in Central America by area
Lake Nicaragua is the largest lake in Central America
Bull sharks swim up the river all the way into this lake
Has 19 volcanoes, some of which allow sledding down
The Caribbean pirogues of the Miskito still ply the coasts

pa.name: Panama
descriptions: The Panama Canal links the Atlantic to the Pacific over 82 km
Over 14,000 ships pass through it every year
Home of the Kuna Indians and their colorful molas
The country is famous for its Panama hat originally from Ecuador
Over 940 bird species live or migrate there

py.name: Paraguay
descriptions: Landlocked South American country between Brazil and Argentina
Officially bilingual with Spanish and Guarani
The Itaipu Dam is one of the most powerful in the world
Tereré is a national drink based on fresh yerba mate
The Jesuits built famous reductions here in the 17th century

pe.name: Peru
descriptions: The Inca city of Machu Picchu sits high in the Andes
Cradle of the potato with over 4,000 varieties
Lake Titicaca borders the country to the south with Bolivia
The Nazca Lines trace huge drawings in the desert
Peruvian gastronomy is recognized among the best in the world

kn.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
descriptions: Smallest country in the Americas by area and population
Composed of two twin volcanic islands
Mount Liamuiga is a dormant volcano 1,156 meters high
The last Caribbean country to gain independence, in 1983
Producer of sugar cane since the British colonial era

lc.name: Saint Lucia
descriptions: Small Caribbean island nicknamed the Helen of the Caribbean
The Pitons are two volcanic peaks UNESCO-listed
Has the world's only drive-in volcano accessible by car
Home of two Nobel laureates: Derek Walcott and Arthur Lewis
French Creole is still spoken throughout the island

vc.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
descriptions: Archipelago of one main island and 32 paradise islets
La Soufrière volcano dominates the main island at 1,234 meters
The film Pirates of the Caribbean was shot on some of its islands
Mustique attracts celebrities from around the world
Arrowroot, starch used in cooking, is grown here

sr.name: Suriname
descriptions: Smallest independent country in South America by area
Only South American country where Dutch is the official language
Covered 93% by primary tropical forest still intact
Very diverse population: Indian, Javanese, Creole and Amerindian
Pom is a national dish based on chicken and tubers

tt.name: Trinidad and Tobago
descriptions: Cradle of calypso and steelpan, instrument made of metal drums
The Port of Spain carnival is one of the largest in the world
Pitch Lake is the largest natural asphalt lake in the world
Has over 470 bird species including colorful hummingbirds
Leading oil producer in the eastern Caribbean

us.name: United States
descriptions: Composed of 50 states covering an immense territory
First country to send men to the Moon in 1969
Has the Grand Canyon, a gorge carved by the Colorado
Home of Hollywood, world capital of cinema
Baseball, basketball and American football are the major sports

uy.name: Uruguay
descriptions: Small South American country bordered by the Rio de la Plata
First country in the Americas where women voted, in 1927
First Football World Cup organized here in 1930
Yerba mate is the national drink shared in a group
Over 60% of the population lives in the capital Montevideo

ve.name: Venezuela
descriptions: Has the highest waterfall in the world, Angel Falls at 979 m
Mount Roraima is a plateau with prehistoric landscapes
First country in the world by proven oil reserves
Home of Simón Bolívar, liberator of several South American countries
Arepa, corn pancake, is the national dish eaten every day

au.name: Australia
descriptions: Sixth largest country in the world by area
Unique home of kangaroos, koalas and platypuses
The Great Barrier Reef is the largest in the world
Uluru is a sacred red rock at the heart of the desert
90% of inhabitants live within 50 km of the coast

fj.name: Fiji
descriptions: Melanesian archipelago of 333 islands in the South Pacific
Has golden sand beaches and coral reefs
Rugby Sevens is the Olympic champion national sport
The kava ceremony brings villagers together around a drink
Over 100 islands are uninhabited and preserved

ki.name: Kiribati
descriptions: Only country in the world straddling all four hemispheres
Has 33 atolls spread over 3.5 million km² of ocean
First country to see the sun rise each morning
Christmas Island is one of the largest atolls in the world
Population lives mainly off fishing and coconuts

mh.name: Marshall Islands
descriptions: Archipelago of 1,156 islands and islets in the Pacific Ocean
Bikini Atoll is sadly famous for its nuclear tests
Kwajalein Atoll is the largest in the world by lagoon surface
Marshallese are excellent navigators with their stick charts
Country threatened by rising waters due to global warming

fm.name: Micronesia
descriptions: Country composed of 607 islands scattered over 2.6 million km²
Yap Island still uses huge stones as traditional currency
Nan Madol is a unique ancient city on basalt stilts
Turquoise waters sheltering sharks, mantas and multicolored corals
The country spans four independent federated states

nr.name: Nauru
descriptions: Third smallest country in the world by area after Vatican and Monaco
Smallest independent republic on the planet
The island is so small you can drive around it in 30 minutes
No official capital, the government sits in Yaren
Has the largest brown booby colony in the Pacific

nz.name: New Zealand
descriptions: Composed of two main islands
Home of the kiwi, iconic flightless bird
Home of the All Blacks and their famous haka
Lord of the Rings landscapes were filmed there
First country in the world to give women the right to vote in 1893

pw.name: Palau
descriptions: Paradise archipelago of over 340 islands in the Pacific Ocean
First country in the world to create a shark sanctuary
Jellyfish Lake contains millions of harmless jellyfish
Ngerulmud is the smallest capital in the world by population
Over 1,500 fish species live in its waters

pg.name: Papua New Guinea
descriptions: Has over 800 different languages, the most in the world
Has the second largest island in the world after Greenland
Shelters birds of paradise and their ornamental plumes
Sepik tribes create famous ritual sculptures
Mount Wilhelm rises to 4,509 metres, the country's highest peak

ws.name: Samoa
descriptions: Polynesian archipelago composed of two main islands
Tatau is the ancestral art of Polynesian tattooing born here
Writer Robert Louis Stevenson lived and is buried here
Home of many international rugby players
Fa'a Samoa is the traditional philosophy of life of the country

sb.name: Solomon Islands
descriptions: Melanesian archipelago of nearly 1,000 islands in the Pacific
Over 70 different languages spoken in the country
Decisive Battle of Guadalcanal during the Second World War
Home to Marovo, the world's largest lagoon enclosed by a double reef
Red betel is traditionally chewed by the entire population

to.name: Tonga
descriptions: Only Polynesian kingdom never colonized by a European power
Composed of 169 islands, only 36 of which are inhabited
Humpback whales come here every year to breed
Rugby is the iconic national sport of the country
Sunday rest is written into the kingdom's constitution

tv.name: Tuvalu
descriptions: Fourth smallest country in the world by area
The country's maximum altitude is only 4.6 meters
Country threatened by rising waters in the Pacific
Its internet domain .tv earns it millions every year
Has one of the smallest populations in the world

vu.name: Vanuatu
descriptions: Volcanic archipelago of 83 islands in the South Pacific
Has over 100 different languages spoken in the country
Yasur volcano is one of the most accessible in the world
Birthplace of the Gol land dive, ancestor of bungee jumping
Often ranked the happiest country in the world by the Happy Planet Index
